日.name: sun
日.meaningMnemonic: A tall box with a bar across the middle, like a window glowing with light. Picture the sun shining through it, so bright the glass seems split in two.

一.name: plank
一.meaningMnemonic: One flat line lying on its side. It is a single wooden plank laid across a muddy path so you can walk over it.

王.name: monarch
王.meaningMnemonic: Three planks stacked and joined by one upright post, like the frame of a throne. Only a monarch gets to sit on something that sturdy.

囗.name: corral
囗.meaningMnemonic: A big empty square with nothing inside yet. It is a corral, a fenced pen waiting for animals to be herded in.

丶.name: speck
丶.meaningMnemonic: A tiny slanted dot, barely there. It is a speck of dust that landed on your page.

人.name: walker
人.meaningMnemonic: Two strokes leaning on each other like a pair of legs mid stride. This is a walker, always heading somewhere on foot.

ノ.name: swoosh
ノ.meaningMnemonic: One curved stroke sweeping down to the left. Hear the swoosh of a brush flicking across paper.

干.name: drying rack
干.meaningMnemonic: Two crossbars hung on a single post. Laundry gets draped over each bar, so this is a drying rack.

乞.name: beggar
乞.meaningMnemonic: A bent little shape with a hand held out, hunched over and hoping. It is a beggar asking for spare change.

大.name: starfish
大.meaningMnemonic: A figure with arms flung wide and legs spread apart. It looks just like a starfish lying flat on the sand.

十.name: plus sign
十.meaningMnemonic: One line across and one line down, crossing in the middle. It is a plus sign, the same one you use in maths.

二.name: bunk beds
二.meaningMnemonic: Two flat lines, one above the other, the top one shorter. They are bunk beds, a small bunk stacked over a big one.

木.name: timber
木.meaningMnemonic: A trunk standing straight with branches above and roots spreading below. Someone shouts timber as it starts to fall.

｜.name: pole
｜.meaningMnemonic: A single straight line standing upright. It is a pole planted firmly in the ground.

口.name: hatch
口.meaningMnemonic: A small square opening. It is a hatch in a ship's deck that you can pop open and climb through.

長.name: long hair
長.meaningMnemonic: Many lines stream down from the top and flow out at the bottom. It is a head of long hair blowing in the wind.

山.name: three peaks
山.meaningMnemonic: Three points rise from one base, the middle one tallest. It is a ridge with three peaks against the sky.

凵.name: bucket
凵.meaningMnemonic: A shape open at the top with walls on both sides. It is a bucket waiting to be filled.

寸.name: inch
寸.meaningMnemonic: A hand with a dot marking a spot on the wrist, the old way to measure a tiny length. That small measure is an inch.

土.name: soil
土.meaningMnemonic: A short line over a long line with a sprout pushing up between them. The long line is the ground, and the sprout grows out of rich soil.

行.name: crossroads
行.meaningMnemonic: Two halves facing each other with gaps between, like streets meeting from four sides. It is a crossroads in the middle of town.

彳.name: side street
彳.meaningMnemonic: This is only the left half of the crossroads, a narrow lane branching off. Call it a side street.

見.name: watcher
見.meaningMnemonic: A big eye perched on top of two legs. It is a watcher who walks around and stares at everything.

目.name: eyeball
目.meaningMnemonic: A tall box with two bars inside, like an eye turned on its side. Picture a round eyeball rolling inside it.

儿.name: stilts
儿.meaningMnemonic: Two long legs and nothing else, one bending out at the bottom. Someone is wobbling along on stilts.

月.name: crescent
月.meaningMnemonic: A tall shape with a curved side and two bars inside. It is a thin crescent hanging in the night sky.

夂.name: dragging feet
夂.meaningMnemonic: A slanted shape that seems to trail behind itself. It is someone walking slowly on dragging feet, in no hurry at all.

幺.name: tiny thread
幺.meaningMnemonic: Two little loops twisted together. It is a tiny thread curled up after being pulled from a sweater.

刈.name: sickle
刈.meaningMnemonic: A sharp blade on one side, ready to cut grain. It is a sickle swinging through a field.

并.name: antlers
并.meaningMnemonic: Two short strokes point up and outward at the top. They are a pair of antlers poking out above a head.

生.name: seedling
生.meaningMnemonic: Lines branch up from the soil like small leaves reaching for light. It is a seedling just breaking through.

五.name: high five
五.meaningMnemonic: A shape with an open frame like a raised palm. Slap it for a high five.

門.name: saloon doors
門.meaningMnemonic: Two matching panels side by side with a gap between. They are saloon doors that swing open when you push through.

卜.name: fortune stick
卜.meaningMnemonic: A straight stick with a short mark sticking off one side. It is a fortune stick shaken from a cup to tell your future.

田.name: paddy
田.meaningMnemonic: A square split into four smaller squares. It is a paddy seen from above, divided into flooded plots.

个.name: umbrella
个.meaningMnemonic: Two strokes spread down and out from one point at the top, like the cloth of an open umbrella. Hold this umbrella over whatever sits beneath it.

金.name: ingot
金.meaningMnemonic: A pointed top over stacked bars, with a glint on each side at the bottom. It is a heavy ingot, freshly cast and ready for the vault.

ハ.name: mustache
ハ.meaningMnemonic: Two short strokes part and sweep outward, one to the left and one to the right. Together they look like a mustache under a big nose.

九.name: elbow
九.meaningMnemonic: A short stroke crosses a long one that bends sharply and kicks out at the end. That sharp bend is an elbow, cocked and ready to nudge someone.

入.name: tunnel
入.meaningMnemonic: Two strokes lean together to make a low, pointed opening. It is the mouth of a tunnel you have to duck to get into.

子.name: toddler
子.meaningMnemonic: A round little head, arms stretched out to the sides, and one leg curled under. It is a toddler wobbling across the floor.

尚.name: steam
尚.meaningMnemonic: Three short strokes rise and fan out at the top of a shape. They are wisps of steam drifting up from something hot.

冖.name: blanket
冖.meaningMnemonic: A flat top with both edges hanging down at the sides. It is a blanket thrown over something to keep it covered.

高.name: tower
高.meaningMnemonic: Boxes stacked one on another under a pointed roof, with a wide frame at the base. It is a tower rising high over the town.

亠.name: thumbtack
亠.meaningMnemonic: A small dot pressed down onto a flat line. It is a thumbtack pinning a note to the top of a board.

冂.name: goalpost
冂.meaningMnemonic: Two upright posts joined by a bar across the top, open at the bottom. It is a goalpost waiting for someone to score.

夕.name: dusk
夕.meaningMnemonic: A slanted moon with a stroke cutting through it, half hidden by cloud. The sun has gone down and it is dusk.

米.name: sparkler
米.meaningMnemonic: A cross with little sparks shooting off in four directions. It is a sparkler fizzing in your hand at a summer festival.

气.name: breath
气.meaningMnemonic: Thin lines drift sideways and curl down at the end. It is your breath, floating out into the air on a cold morning.

小.name: splash
小.meaningMnemonic: One drop falls straight down and two droplets jump out to either side. It is a little splash in a puddle.

乙.name: swan
乙.meaningMnemonic: One stroke folds back on itself and curls out at the bottom, like a long graceful neck. It is a swan gliding across a pond.

匕.name: ladle
匕.meaningMnemonic: A short slanted stroke and a long one that bends into a scoop at the bottom. It is a ladle for serving soup.

言.name: megaphone
言.meaningMnemonic: Lines of words pile up on top of an open mouth. It is a megaphone, making every word loud enough to hear across the field.

舌.name: lollipop
舌.meaningMnemonic: A long stick with a crossbar pokes out of an open mouth. Someone is happily sucking on a lollipop.

女.name: dancer
女.meaningMnemonic: A figure with crossed legs and one arm swung wide, caught in the middle of a spin. It is a dancer twirling on the stage.

爿.name: ladder
爿.meaningMnemonic: A tall post with short rungs sticking out on one side. It is a ladder leaning on the wall, waiting to be climbed.

白.name: milk carton
白.meaningMnemonic: A tall box with a little slanted spout on top. It is a milk carton, full of something white.

聿.name: quill
聿.meaningMnemonic: A hand grips a long upright stick crossed by several lines. It is a quill held ready to write.

川.name: creek
川.meaningMnemonic: Three lines run down side by side, the middle one a little shorter. Water trickles along between them like a creek.

水.name: fountain
水.meaningMnemonic: A tall jet shoots up the middle with water spraying out to both sides. It is a fountain in the town square.

力.name: muscle
力.meaningMnemonic: A bent stroke with a hook, like an arm curled up tight. Flex it and show off your muscle.

西.name: cookie jar
西.meaningMnemonic: A square jar with a lid on top and two lines poking up inside. It is a cookie jar, and somebody keeps sneaking a hand in.

雨.name: drizzle
雨.meaningMnemonic: A wide roof of cloud with four drops falling inside it. It is a steady drizzle that soaks everything.

父.name: scissors
父.meaningMnemonic: Two blades cross in the middle with two little handles poking up on top. It is a pair of scissors, open and ready to snip.

耳.name: earlobe
耳.meaningMnemonic: A tall frame with ridges inside and one side stretching down low. It is an earlobe, the soft bit you can tug.

食.name: lunchbox
食.meaningMnemonic: A lid on top, a box of food underneath, and a little spoon at the side. It is your lunchbox, packed and ready.

車.name: wagon
車.meaningMnemonic: A box on an axle with a wheel at each end, seen from above. It is a wagon rolling down the road.

化.name: sidekick
化.meaningMnemonic: A slim figure standing tall at the left edge of a kanji, always beside someone else. It is a sidekick, never the hero but always there.

亅.name: fishhook
亅.meaningMnemonic: A straight line drops down and curls back up at the bottom. It is a fishhook dangling on its line.

母.name: bird nest
母.meaningMnemonic: A rounded frame with two little eggs tucked inside. It is a bird nest, warm and well guarded.

毋.name: barricade
毋.meaningMnemonic: A frame with one long bar slashing straight through it. It is a barricade that says nobody gets past.

火.name: campfire
火.meaningMnemonic: A figure in the middle with sparks leaping off both sides. It is a campfire crackling in the dark.

士.name: knight
士.meaningMnemonic: Like soil, but here the top line is the long one, standing proud over a short base. It is a knight with chest out, ready to serve.

又.name: crossed fingers
又.meaningMnemonic: A stroke folds over and crosses itself, like two fingers twisted together. Keep your crossed fingers up and hope for luck.

工.name: girder
工.meaningMnemonic: A flat top, a flat bottom, and one post between them. It is a steel girder, the beam builders bolt into every frame.

厶.name: arrowhead
厶.meaningMnemonic: A small bent stroke with a tail, pointed like a tiny triangle. It is a stone arrowhead you might dig up in a field.

ヨ.name: rake
ヨ.meaningMnemonic: Three short teeth sticking out from one side of a bar. Drag this rake across the lawn and it gathers the leaves.

自.name: self portrait
自.meaningMnemonic: A frame with a little tick on top and lines inside like a face. It is a self portrait an artist painted while staring in a mirror.

礼.name: altar
礼.meaningMnemonic: A small stand with a mark on top, like a table with an offering on it. People bow in front of this altar.

癶.name: footprints
癶.meaningMnemonic: Two sets of marks splaying out left and right at the top. They are footprints in the snow, heading off in two directions.

老.name: walking cane
老.meaningMnemonic: Soil on top and a long slanting stroke cutting through it. That slant is a walking cane, leaning on the ground for support.

也.name: whip
也.meaningMnemonic: A curling stroke that loops and snaps back on itself. It is a whip, cracking through the air.

羊.name: ram
羊.meaningMnemonic: Two horns on top and a body made of stacked lines. It is a ram, lowering its curled horns to charge.

耒.name: plow
耒.meaningMnemonic: A post with many crossbars and two legs that dig into the dirt. It is an old wooden plow pulled across a field.

方.name: signpost
方.meaningMnemonic: A dot on top, a crossbar, and an arm pointing off to the side. It is a signpost showing travelers which way to go.

斤.name: woodcutter axe
斤.meaningMnemonic: A blade on top and a long handle swinging down. It is a woodcutter axe, ready to split a log.

辛.name: chili pepper
辛.meaningMnemonic: A tall shape that narrows to a sharp point at the bottom. It is a chili pepper, so hot it makes your eyes water.

立.name: podium
立.meaningMnemonic: A dot on top, a little stand, and a long base on the ground. It is a podium where a speaker steps up to talk.

勿.name: banner
勿.meaningMnemonic: A bent pole with streaks hanging down from it. It is a banner flapping in the wind at a parade.

貝.name: clam
貝.meaningMnemonic: An eyeball shape sitting on two small legs. It is a clam peeking out of its shell on the beach.

廾.name: pliers
廾.meaningMnemonic: Two prongs joined by a crossbar, like the handles of a tool. They are pliers, gripping something tight.

手.name: palm
手.meaningMnemonic: A curved top and lines branching from a center stroke like fingers. It is an open palm, raised to wave hello.

弋.name: stake
弋.meaningMnemonic: A stroke with a hook at the bottom and a dot at the top right. It is a tent stake hammered into the ground.

里.name: farmstead
里.meaningMnemonic: A paddy sitting on top of soil. Fields on good land make a farmstead, where a family lives and farms.

込.name: conveyor belt
込.meaningMnemonic: A long stroke that sweeps along the bottom and carries what sits on it. It is a conveyor belt moving things from one place to another.

用.name: toolbox
用.meaningMnemonic: A box with handles and bars across it. It is a toolbox you open whenever there is a job to do.

マ.name: pennant
マ.meaningMnemonic: A small triangle with a tail hanging from it. It is a pennant flying from the top of a pole.

疋.name: bolt of cloth
疋.meaningMnemonic: A shape that folds over and spreads out at the bottom. It is a bolt of cloth, unrolled across a table.

頁.name: page
頁.meaningMnemonic: A flat line on top over a box that stands on legs. It is a page torn out of a book, standing up on its own.

音.name: chime
音.meaningMnemonic: A podium sitting on top of the sun. A chime hangs from that podium and rings every morning at sunrise.

心.name: pulse
心.meaningMnemonic: Three little beats and one curved stroke. It is a pulse, thumping in your chest and wrist.

广.name: carport
广.meaningMnemonic: A dot and a roof that slopes down only on one side. It is a carport, a roof with no walls where you park the car.

弓.name: archer
弓.meaningMnemonic: A stroke that bends back and forth like a drawn bow. An archer holds it, ready to shoot.

虫.name: beetle
虫.meaningMnemonic: A small body with legs and a tiny tail. It is a beetle crawling along a leaf.

扎.name: grabber
扎.meaningMnemonic: A short hook with a crossbar on the left side. It is a grabber, the claw tool you use to pick things up.

矛.name: halberd
矛.meaningMnemonic: A long shaft with a hooked blade at the top. It is a halberd, carried by a palace guard.

宀.name: attic
宀.meaningMnemonic: A dot on top and a roof that covers everything below. It is the attic, the space right under the roof.

豕.name: hog
豕.meaningMnemonic: A body with many short legs and a stroke like a snout. It is a hog snuffling around in the mud.

世.name: trellis
世.meaningMnemonic: Three upright posts joined by bars across the middle. It is a garden trellis with vines climbing it.

止.name: stop sign
止.meaningMnemonic: A post with a short arm and a long flat base. It is a stop sign planted at the corner.

阡.name: staircase
阡.meaningMnemonic: A tall stroke with steps sticking out of the side. It is a staircase climbing up a wall.

元.name: kickoff
元.meaningMnemonic: Two lines on top and stilts underneath. It is the kickoff, the moment a game first begins.

攵.name: baton
攵.meaningMnemonic: A short stroke and a long sweeping cross. It is a baton, swung by a conductor or passed in a relay race.

文.name: calligraphy
文.meaningMnemonic: A dot, a line, and two strokes that cross with style. It is calligraphy, written with a soft brush.

勹.name: hood
勹.meaningMnemonic: A stroke that bends down and wraps around whatever is under it. It is a hood pulled over someone's head.

汁.name: droplets
汁.meaningMnemonic: Three little marks running down the left side. They are droplets of water, dripping one after another.

矢.name: dart
矢.meaningMnemonic: A short stroke on top, a crossbar, and two flights at the bottom. It is a dart flying toward the board.

首.name: scarf
首.meaningMnemonic: Two marks on top over a self portrait. The person in the portrait is wearing a scarf wrapped around the throat.

隹.name: pigeon
隹.meaningMnemonic: A small body with many stacked feathers. It is a pigeon puffing up its chest in the park.

牛.name: ox
牛.meaningMnemonic: Two horns and a body with a line straight through it. It is an ox, strong enough to pull a cart.

品.name: crate stack
品.meaningMnemonic: One hatch on top and two below. It is a crate stack in a warehouse, boxes piled on boxes.

歹.name: bones
歹.meaningMnemonic: A plank on top and a bent shape underneath. They are dry bones left out in the desert.

禾.name: wheat stalk
禾.meaningMnemonic: A timber shape with a little stroke drooping from the top. It is a wheat stalk, bending under the weight of its grain.

糸.name: spool
糸.meaningMnemonic: Little loops twist down to a base with three tails. It is a spool, its thread winding round and round.

斗.name: measuring scoop
斗.meaningMnemonic: Two dots lean on a long handle crossed by a bar. It is a measuring scoop, with grains spilling off the side.

廴.name: slide
廴.meaningMnemonic: One stroke zigzags down and then runs long and flat along the bottom. It is a slide in the playground.

穴.name: burrow
穴.meaningMnemonic: A roof with two little legs under it, an opening in the ground. It is a burrow where a rabbit hides.

刀.name: cleaver
刀.meaningMnemonic: A bent stroke with a sharp edge hooking down. It is a cleaver hanging in the kitchen.

石.name: pebble
石.meaningMnemonic: A slanted cliff with a small square box at its foot. That box is a pebble that rolled down.

足.name: sneaker
足.meaningMnemonic: A box on top of a shape that kicks out to the side. It is a sneaker, ready to run.

冫.name: icicles
冫.meaningMnemonic: Two short drops, one over the other, hanging on the left. They are icicles dripping from the eaves.

走.name: sprinter
走.meaningMnemonic: Soil on top and a leg stretching long underneath. It is a sprinter pushing off the ground.

已.name: coil
已.meaningMnemonic: A stroke that bends back on itself and curls up at the end. It is a coil of rope on a dock.

疔.name: sickbed
疔.meaningMnemonic: A roof with little drops on its left side, like a fever sweat. It is a sickbed where someone rests.

艮.name: glare
艮.meaningMnemonic: An eye shape on top, with legs kicking out below. It is a glare, a stubborn stare that will not move.

馬.name: stallion
馬.meaningMnemonic: A mane on top, four legs below, and a swishing tail. It is a stallion galloping across the field.

杰.name: embers
杰.meaningMnemonic: Four little dots in a row along the bottom. They are embers glowing under a pot.

艾.name: sprouts
艾.meaningMnemonic: Two short stalks poke up through a line of earth. They are sprouts, the first green of the year.

匚.name: tray
匚.meaningMnemonic: A flat top, a flat bottom, and one side to hold them together. It is a tray tipped on its side.

竹.name: bamboo grove
竹.meaningMnemonic: Two stalks stand side by side with leaves fanning off the top. It is a bamboo grove.

巾.name: napkin
巾.meaningMnemonic: A cloth hangs from a pole straight down the middle. It is a napkin tucked into a collar.

欠.name: sneeze
欠.meaningMnemonic: A head tilted back and a wide open mouth spraying out below. It is a sneeze.

買.name: fishing net
買.meaningMnemonic: A wide box divided into little squares across the top. It is a fishing net spread out to dry.

至.name: finish line
至.meaningMnemonic: A line on top, an arrowhead pointing down, and soil below. The arrow lands right on the finish line.

風.name: gale
風.meaningMnemonic: A big frame with something swirling inside it. It is a gale blowing through an open door.

几.name: stool
几.meaningMnemonic: Two legs and a flat seat that curls at the end. It is a stool in the corner.

氏.name: clan
氏.meaningMnemonic: A long stroke with branches hanging off it, like a family tree. It is a clan and all its relatives.

黒.name: soot
黒.meaningMnemonic: A smoky window over embers that keep burning. Everything is covered in soot.

赤.name: blush
赤.meaningMnemonic: Soil on top and flickering flames below. Your cheeks glow with a blush.

青.name: clear sky
青.meaningMnemonic: A sprout on top and a crescent moon below. You see it all under a clear sky.

尸.name: awning
尸.meaningMnemonic: A flat top with a side that hangs down to the left. It is an awning over a shop door.

色.name: palette
色.meaningMnemonic: A shape with a curl on top and a swirl underneath. It is a palette with paint mixed on it.

巴.name: whirlpool
巴.meaningMnemonic: A box with a tail that curls out and around at the bottom. It is a whirlpool spinning in the river.

羽.name: wings
羽.meaningMnemonic: Two matching shapes, each with feathers tucked inside. They are a pair of wings.

卩.name: kneeler
卩.meaningMnemonic: A shape bent forward with one leg tucked under it. It is a kneeler, someone down on one knee.

肉.name: steak
肉.meaningMnemonic: A frame with two little cuts marked inside it. It is a steak on the butcher's board.

鳥.name: songbird
鳥.meaningMnemonic: A head with a beak on top, a body, and a tail of embers underneath. It is a songbird ready to sing.

厂.name: overhang
厂.meaningMnemonic: A flat top with a long side sweeping down to the left. It is an overhang of rock you can shelter under.

免.name: loophole
免.meaningMnemonic: A shape with a little gap and legs running out of the bottom. It is a loophole you slip right through.

魚.name: trout
魚.meaningMnemonic: A pointed head, a scaly body, and a fanned tail below. It is a trout jumping out of the stream.

犬.name: puppy
犬.meaningMnemonic: A starfish shape with one extra dot by its ear. It is a puppy with its ear flopped over.

戈.name: pike
戈.meaningMnemonic: A long shaft with a blade crossing it and a tassel on top. It is a pike carried by a guard.

邦.name: hamlet
邦.meaningMnemonic: A little bump on the right side, like a flag on a hill. It marks a hamlet out in the countryside.

ユ.name: bracket
ユ.meaningMnemonic: A square shape with one side left open. It is a bracket holding up a shelf.

衣.name: robe
衣.meaningMnemonic: A collar on top and long folds that swing out below. It is a robe hanging on a hook.

忙.name: heartbeat
忙.meaningMnemonic: A tall stroke with a flick on each side, like a line on a monitor. It is a heartbeat.

甘.name: honey
甘.meaningMnemonic: A little box with two posts poking out of the top, like a jar. It is a jar of honey.

爪.name: claws
爪.meaningMnemonic: Three sharp strokes curving down from a curved top. They are claws ready to scratch.

初.name: debut
初.meaningMnemonic: A robe next to a cleaver: you cut the cloth for your first outfit. It is your debut.

支.name: twig
支.meaningMnemonic: A small plus shape on top of crossed strokes. It is a twig snapped off a branch.

斉.name: lineup
斉.meaningMnemonic: A neat shape with everything stacked in even rows. It is a lineup, all standing in order.

角.name: tusk
角.meaningMnemonic: A curved point on top of a boxy body with lines inside. It is a tusk, sharp at the tip.

示.name: shrine
示.meaningMnemonic: Two lines on top of a small stand with feet. It is a shrine where people leave offerings.

面.name: visor
面.meaningMnemonic: A frame with an eye slot across the middle. It is a visor that covers your face.

彡.name: three hairs
彡.meaningMnemonic: Three short strokes slanting side by side. They are three hairs sticking out.

戸.name: screen door
戸.meaningMnemonic: A flat top over a frame that swings to the side. It is a screen door.

冊.name: booklet
冊.meaningMnemonic: Upright strips tied together with one line across. It is a booklet bound with string.

殳.name: cudgel
殳.meaningMnemonic: A little hand on top holding a weapon below. It is a cudgel ready to swing.

谷.name: canyon
谷.meaningMnemonic: Two pairs of strokes spreading apart over an opening. It is a canyon between two cliffs.

韋.name: rawhide
韋.meaningMnemonic: Strips stacked top and bottom with a tie through the middle. It is rawhide stretched to dry.

釆.name: paw print
釆.meaningMnemonic: A dot of a heel with little toes spreading out below. It is a paw print in the mud.

酉.name: wine jug
酉.meaningMnemonic: A lid on top of a round body with a line of liquid inside. It is a wine jug.

豆.name: lentil
豆.meaningMnemonic: A lid, a little round box, and a stand. It is a lentil bowl on the table.

亡.name: phantom
亡.meaningMnemonic: A thumbtack shape over a corner that fades away. It is a phantom slipping out of sight.

非.name: zipper
非.meaningMnemonic: Two rows of teeth facing each other down a center line. It is a zipper.

黄.name: saffron
黄.meaningMnemonic: A field with sprouts on top and legs below. It is a field of saffron flowers.

井.name: tic tac toe
井.meaningMnemonic: Two lines across and two lines down. It is a tic tac toe board.
